description: React component for a filter control card used in Apache Superset's dashboard native filters, specifically for 'Group By' filter configuration with UI elements, state management, and dataset column fetching.

classes.name: GroupByFilterCard
classes.description: React functional component for rendering a 'Group By' filter card with dataset column selection, popover info, and layout options.

classes.name: GroupByFilterCardContent
classes.description: Subcomponent rendering detailed info about the filter, including dataset, type, and aggregation, used within popovers.

methods.name: hideHoverCard
methods.description: Hides the hover popover for the filter card.

methods.name: setHoveredChartCustomization
methods.description: Dispatches hover action for the chart customization.

methods.name: unsetHoveredChartCustomization
methods.description: Removes hover state for the chart customization.

methods.name: handleColumnChange
methods.description: Handles change in selected dataset column, updates filter state and dispatches pending customization.
